Subject: Post-call: ACME Health — Private VPC / On‑Prem discovery recap

Thanks for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call:

Pain points & drivers
- Data residency and PHI concerns: ACME needs all PHI processing to remain within ACME-controlled networks; SOC2 evidence will be required.
- Air‑gapped/on‑prem option: some sites will not allow outbound internet traffic; installers or private control plane required.
- Latency and reliability for real‑time triage workflows — sub‑200ms target for inference in key sites.
- Key management: HSM/KMS integration for encryption at rest and in transit.

Goals
- Run a 4‑week POC in a single region/site (on‑prem or VPC peered) to validate latency and data flows.
- Produce an SOW and high‑level sizing + pricing for Dedicated/Private deployment options.

Action items / next steps
1) SE deep‑dive to validate network constraints and collect diagram (Dev to lead).
2) We will share our Private deployment overview and a network checklist (attached).
3) ACME to share detailed network diagram and any procurement timelines. Procurement contact cc’d if helpful.
4) Target POC start: early Q1 (subject to procurement).

Attachments: redwood-private-overview.pdf, network-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with SE availability for next week.

— Camila

- Procurement asked for an initial ballpark for POC cost and any licensing model (monthly vs committed). Can you share a sample SOW and rough pricing range so we can align budget?
- For the SE call, evenings next week (Mon/Wed) are best for our infra team.

Thanks — a couple of technical notes from our side:

1) Air‑gapped sites: these locations cannot initiate outbound connections to the public internet. Any installer or control plane must be deployable behind our perimeter. For cloud‑adjacent sites we can consider VPC peering or private endpoints.
2) Ports/hosts: if you can provide a minimal list of required egress endpoints/ports for a hybrid setup that would help our firewall team. Ideally we’d prefer an offline installer plus a private control plane option.
3) KMS/HSM: must support internal HSM or customer‑managed KMS; we cannot export keys to third‑party cloud KMS.
4) Audit/logging: SOC2 evidence and detailed audit logs required for signoff.

Attaching our initial network requirements doc: acme_network_req.pdf

Samir
